title: ozoroa dekindtiana
intro: Ozoroa dekindtiana, commonly known as the African Birch or the Red Birch, is a plant species belonging to the family Anacardiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
